name: Michelle Ryan
interests: Ecological health of waterways, community engagement with a focus on education to improve overall water health.
bio: Michelle Ryan is an academic at Wester Sydney University who is passionate about improving waterway health. Michelle works with a number of community groups to improve awareness and increase education on water issues on a number of local, national and global issues. Michelle is a passionate educator and researcher. Michelle’s current research areas focus on the biological aspect of waterways, currently researching platypus, freshwater turtles and macroinvertebrates in the Sydney basin.
